description: nmap -sS -f from 203.0.113.80 against ports 22, 80 and 443: each 20-byte TCP header is split into fragments of 8, 8 and 4 bytes. The 6 non-final fragments are tiny; the first fragment of each carries only 8 bytes of the TCP header, which is the reason given.

details.reason: first fragment carries 8 bytes of the TCP header, need 20
